description: This file defines the interface for rtConnection, a core component managing communication channels, message sending, and listening callbacks within the RT messaging framework. It includes function declarations for creating, destroying, and interacting with rtConnection objects, as well as callback and listener management.

methods.name: rtConnection_Create
methods.description: Creates a new RT connection instance using application name and router configuration.

methods.name: rtConnection_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys an existing RT connection instance.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message on a specified topic.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendMessageDirect
methods.description: Sends a message directly to a specific listener on a topic.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message and waits for a response.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response to a received message request.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinary
methods.description: Sends a binary payload as a message on a topic.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinaryDirect
methods.description: Sends a binary payload directly to a specific listener.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinaryRequest
methods.description: Sends a binary request and receives a binary response.

methods.name: rtConnection_SendBinaryResponse
methods.description: Sends a binary response to a request.

methods.name: rtConnection_AddListener
methods.description: Registers a callback listener for messages matching an expression.

methods.name: rtConnection_RemoveListener
methods.description: Removes a message listener registered by expression.

methods.name: rtConnection_AddAlias
methods.description: Adds an alias for an existing listener.

methods.name: rtConnection_RemoveAlias
methods.description: Removes an alias from an existing listener.

methods.name: rtConnection_AddDefaultListener
methods.description: Registers a default message callback for all messages.

methods.name: rtConnection_GetReturnAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the return address associated with the connection.

methods.name: rtConnection_Dispatch
methods.description: Processes incoming messages; implementation-specific, legacy note.
